analogy.rationale: Microtubule inhibitors stabilize or destabilize tubulin polymers, causing mitotic arrest; tubulin polymerization inhibitors share the same direct target and downstream mitotic program. Aurora kinase, PLK, and CDK inhibitors also converge on mitotic arrest, while kinesin inhibitors disrupt spindle function, yielding overlapping transcriptional responses.
